name: Trirealm Rift Savage Storms
effectText: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) 7 cards from the top of your Deck. (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card and 1 "Trirealm Rift" card in your hand; banish both those cards (face-down), and if you do, draw 2 cards. You can only use this effect of "Trirealm Rift Savage Storms" once per turn. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can shuffle 1 of your face-down banished "Trirealm Rift" monsters into the Deck, then you can shuffle 1 monster your opponent controls with the same Attribute as that monster into the Deck.
